text:
nora: Heads-up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-central starting ~11:05 UTC. Controller-manager restarted twice. Seems tied to a GPU attach burst.
diego: Confirming alerts. nat-b conntrack hit 128k (limit) during the attach wave. SYNs dropped.
sam: Etcd leader shows compaction started at 11:05:12, wal fsync p95 spiked ~600ms and follower lag grew. Leader flipped briefly.
nora: Apiserver logs: `dial tcp 10.2.8.5:2379: connect: connection refused` and `clientv3: etcdserver: request timed out`.
diego: Immediate mitigations: patched autoscaler to reduce burst concurrency (MAX_ATTACH=4), bumped conntrack: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` on nat-b, opened CLOUD-11001 for SNAT capacity.
sam: Cordoned the new GPU node pool and paused attach jobs. Controller-manager OOM on ctrl-1 noted in journal.
infra-bot: Noted: controller-manager on eu-central-ctrl-1 restarted 2 times between 11:06–11:08 UTC.
k8s-bot: Canary: routed 25% model-serving reads to eu-west at 11:10 UTC to reduce apiserver load.
nora: Current status: conntrack down to 82k, apiserver 5xx <=1% last 5m.
diego: Follow-ups: autoscaler smoothing PR, autoscaler should watch `apiserver_5xx` + `conntrack_utilization` before burst. Evaluate compaction jitter on etcd side.
sam: Postmortem items: compaction timing collision, autoscaler burst lacks soft-splay, controller-manager memory headroom for large reconciles.
nora: I'll draft the postmortem and runbook changes. Leaving thread open until metrics are archived. :white_check_mark:
